title: Marketing and Advertising Agency in Lebanon - Spirit

facts.fact: Spirit describes itself as one of the leading creative advertising agencies in Beirut and Dubai.
facts.quote: We are one of the leading creative advertising agencies in Beirut and Dubai, offering a wide range of services

facts.fact: Spirit's Beirut office is listed at 139, Charles Malek Avenue.
Spirit's Beirut office phone number is listed as +961 21 333 991.
Spirit's Dubai office is listed at Dubai Media City, Business Center.
Spirit's Creative service category lists Branding, Communication Campaigns, Creative Copywriting, Moodboards and Visual Direction, and Photoshoots and Productions.
facts.quote:
Communication Campaigns  
Creative Copywriting  
Moodboards and Visual Direction

facts.quote:

facts.fact: Spirit's PR & Events service category lists Events management and Media coverage.
Spirit's founder Hani Haddad states that the agency combines creative marketing and communication sectors under one roof.

facts.fact: The page's client list includes Middle East Airlines as a named client.
